title: MCR3U Functions Quiz
subtitle: 3 questions. Pick before the timer hits zero.
endPrompt: How many did you get right?

questions.explanation: Restrictions come from denominator zeros: $(x-4)(x+1)=0$, so $x \neq 4,-1$.
The radicand must be non-negative: $-(x-3) \geq 0$, so $x \leq 3$.

questions.prompt: A bacteria culture starts with $500$ cells and triples every $4$ hours. Let $t$ be time in hours and $P(t)$ be the number of cells. Which model represents the situation?
questions.explanation: Tripling every $4$ hours means the exponent counts groups of $4$ hours: $P(t)=500(3)^{t/4}$.
